summary: Cogent Biosciences filed an 8-K reporting entry into a commercial supply agreement with Hovione FarmaCiencia S.A. for manufacturing bezuclastinib spray-dried dispersion and tablets. The agreement involves rolling forecasts, minimum purchase requirements that decrease over time, a five-year initial term with auto-renewals, and termination rights for breach, force majeure, insolvency, or regulatory changes. This is a routine supply contract, not a special situation. No financial terms, prices, or unusual structural features were disclosed; the agreement will be filed as an exhibit to the next 10-Q.
